newsitem.title: FRANCE: French list arms programmes for new agency.
newsitem.headline: French list arms programmes for new agency.

text.p: French officials said on Wednesday that a new European arms agency would handle research and development for programmes as varied as spy satellites and self-propelled artillery pieces.

The officials told reporters that the newly-created "Organisation for Joint Cooperation in Armaments (OCCAR)", would be in charge of many programmes including Milan and Hot anti-tank missiles and the Tiger helicopter gunship.

Others would include Cobra radar systems, the VBCI common infantry fighting vehicle, a new-generation anti-ship weapon, the Brevel drone, Helios-2 and Horus spy satellites, the FACF future surface-to-air missile family and the self-propelled BZH 2000 cannon.
OCCAR was officially created on Tuesday in Strasbourg, eastern France by the defence ministers of France, Germany, Britain and Italy.

The body is based on existing Franco-German arms programmes with which Britain and Italy have asked to be associated, and will be headed for its first three years by a French national with a German deputy, officials said.
It is expected to launch research programmes and was created as part of joint efforts to form a continent-wide arms agency, French officials said.
